**

Fresco cucina italiana in Tirol

** Discover the vibrant flavors of **Fresco**—a cozy Italian-inspired restaurant nestled in the heart of **Tirol**, where authentic Italian cuisine meets Alpine charm. Just a short stroll from **Innsbruck’s** bustling center, this hidden gem invites you to savor handcrafted pasta, crispy **bruschetta**, and rich **tiramisu**—all prepared with fresh, local ingredients. Indulge in a warm **Kaiserschmarrn** for breakfast or enjoy a glass of fine **Chianti** with your meal. Whether you’re craving a quick **panino** or a hearty **risotto**, **Fresco** promises a taste of Italy in the stunning backdrop of the **Tiroler Alpen**. Perfect for a romantic dinner, a family outing, or a solo escape, this restaurant blends Italian passion with the relaxed vibe of the mountains. **Buon appetito!**
